title: Claude Code: Agent view
summary: claude agents opens a terminal screen of all background local sessions: each row has a state (Working, Needs input, Idle, Completed, Failed, Stopped), a one-line summary (the question for a session that needs you) and a PR label, grouped Pinned, Ready for review, Needs input, Working, Completed. Space peeks and replies, Enter attaches. claude agents --json gives scripts the state. Local sessions only, research preview. Only the first 100,000 of about 148,000 characters were read.
ideas: Needs input with the question as the summary is exactly what a gate row needs.
A JSON listing of session states lets a mod or script read them.
Local only: it does not list cloud threads.

took.idea: A row per thread with its waiting question
